cc_updates.body: Fixed a crash in the permission dialog when an agent teams teammate requested tool permission

Changed the CLI to spawn a native Claude Code binary (via a per-platform optional dependency) instead of bundled JavaScript. Added `sandbox.network.deniedDomains` setting to block specific domains. Fullscreen mode: Shift+↑/↓ now scrolls the viewport when extending a selection past the visible edge. `Ctrl+A` and `Ctrl+E` now move to the start/end of the current logical line in multiline input. Windows: `Ctrl+Backspace` now deletes the previous word. Long URLs in responses and bash output stay clickable when they wrap across lines. Improved `/loop`: pressing Esc now cancels pending wakeups. `/extra-usage` now works from Remote Control clients. Remote Control clients can now query `@`-file autocomplete suggestions. Improved `/ultrareview`: faster launch with parallelized checks, diffstat in the launch dialog, and animated launching state. Subagents that stall mid-stream now fail with a clear error after 10 minutes. Multiple security improvements and bug fixes.
Fixed "claude-opus-4-7 is temporarily unavailable" for auto mode
